why_use_section.title: Why We Build with GraphQL
why_use_section.subtitle: GraphQL provides a superior developer experience and network efficiency for modern application delivery.
paragraphs: Traditional REST APIs often lead to 'n+1' query problems and massive over-fetching of data. GraphQL solves this by allowing clients to define the structure of the response, reducing payload sizes and increasing mobile app performance.

By implementing a robust GraphQL layer, we provide a single entry point for your entire data ecosystem, making it easier to integrate legacy systems with modern microservices through a unified schema.
